sentences.en: Girls wearing mini-skirts, walking or sitting, are very effective eye-openers.
sentences.zh: 穿着迷你裙的女孩们，无论是步行还是坐着，都非常引人注目。

sentences.en: That old man is, so to speak, a walking dictionary.
sentences.zh: 那个老人可以说是活字典。

sentences.en: The bear is walking up and down in the cage.
sentences.zh: 那只熊在笼子里来回走动。
